reference_families.people_activity: guided walking, climbing, looking and learning
reference_families.edge_background: adobe platforms, city skyline, flora/fauna park and exhibition room
reference_families.proves: The current visitor description verifies a route from excavated fabric to an elevated city view, enabling architecture to channel movement and temporal comparison.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Exact 2026 crowd rhythm, professional-photography permission or a non-cliché skyline alignment.

reference_families.proves: A 2026 program corroborates both day and night visits plus participatory activity, so time and human presence materially change the site's reading.
reference_families.cannot_prove: That a comparable performance will recur or that night access includes the Great Pyramid.

reference_families.edge_background: excavation areas, archaeological strata and tools
reference_families.proves: The June–July 2026 activity shows Pucllana as an actively researched construction rather than a static ruin, a stronger present/past mechanism.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Ongoing public excavation after the published period or permission to photograph participants.

reference_families.people_activity: museum visiting; exact occupation not established
reference_families.edge_background: early-twentieth-century house, stained glass, gardens and architectural details
reference_families.proves: The institution identifies the house itself as part of the experience, supporting detail-to-whole and garden-to-interior studies.
reference_families.cannot_prove: A permitted interior camera position or current crowd density.

reference_families.edge_background: historic house, gardens, Pedro de Osma avenue and surrounding Barranco fabric
reference_families.proves: A 2026 institutional program explicitly links the house and garden to the surrounding avenue and everyday urban history.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Future recurrence, route access outside the event or a one-frame house/avenue relation.

reference_families.people_activity: arriving, joining mediated tours and circulating
reference_families.edge_background: avenue address, entrance, accessible route and museum plan
reference_families.proves: The current visitor page corroborates active mediated routes but prohibits interior photography and requires coordination for professional work.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Competition-photography authorization; interior concepts remain fail-closed until direct confirmation.

reference_families.people_activity: walking, playing, pausing and looking toward the ocean
reference_families.edge_background: Nazca figures, family area, cliff-top lawn and Pacific horizon
reference_families.proves: The recovered public space combines symbolic ground figures with family use and a cliff-top ocean outlook.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Current planting, precise sunset alignment or a gesture that makes the symbols architectural rather than decorative.

reference_families.edge_background: illuminated figures, dark lawn and coastal city light
reference_families.proves: Night illumination turns ground geometry into a legible spatial field and creates a distinct time-dependent mechanism.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Full 2026 system operation, color consistency or best camera elevation.

reference_families.proves: The lighting is infrastructure with maintenance failure and repair, not a guaranteed scenic effect.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Present condition on the intended shoot date; verify before route.

reference_families.edge_background: timber bridge, Bajada de Baños, vegetation and ravine walls
reference_families.proves: The municipal account links the bridge to a much older natural descent, so the useful unit is crossing-over-route rather than the bridge alone.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Current congestion, repair state or a quiet anti-postal position.

reference_families.people_activity: descending, climbing, selling and passing through
reference_families.edge_background: narrow descending path, façades, vegetation and coastal opening
reference_families.proves: The descent is a persistent topographic corridor whose constriction can visibly channel contemporary movement.
reference_families.cannot_prove: A specific vendor or pedestrian cadence, coastal visibility or edge clutter.

reference_families.people_activity: walking where mechanized descent once operated nearby
reference_families.edge_background: Bajada corridor and memory of the 1896 hydraulic funicular
reference_families.proves: The documented former funicular supplies a temporal-layer hypothesis for movement infrastructure around the descent.
reference_families.cannot_prove: That physical funicular remains are visible in one frame; reject the concept if field evidence cannot show residue without a caption.
